question: Can even vast material wealth compare to the value of this teaching?
premises: One might possess an ocean filled with jewels.
The comparison implies something greater than wealth.
inference: Therefore even immense material wealth is not an adequate price for this teaching.
uncertainties: The token ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is irregular and interpreted from context.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to make the ocean filled with jewels...
